summary: Full e2e test of Anaita Pal 3D portfolio. Backend contact API (POST/GET/validation) and root endpoint all pass (5/5 pytest). Frontend: preloader dismisses, hero canvas + title render, nav navigates to all sections, About/Skills(12)/Projects(4)/Experience(4)/Testimonials(prev/next) all present. Contact form submits POST /api/contact successfully and Sonner toast 'Message sent' shown. Zero console/JS errors.
action_items: MINOR/NAMING: Review request refers to nav link testId 'nav-link-work' but actual testId is 'nav-link-projects' (UI label 'WORK'). Either rename testId to 'nav-link-work' to match user-facing label, or update the request spec. Current implementation works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 85 references `logger` before it's defined (logger initialized on line 112). If /api/contact raises an exception, this will NameError inside the except handler and mask the real error. Move logger init above endpoints.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is not spec-compliant (browsers reject). Currently harmless for public portfolio but should be tightened for prod.
seed_data_creation: Test contact records with name prefix 'TEST_QA Bot' and 'QA Bot' inserted into contacts collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py covers root + contact CRUD/validation. Frontend testIds in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/portfolio.js — note nav uses 'nav-link-projects' (not nav-link-work) and contact inputs use 'contact-input-{name|email|message}'. Preloader takes ~2.1s; wait ~4s before assertions.
